description: This file contains Kotlin code related to image processing in the chat UI of an Android app. It includes functions for loading, resizing, encoding, decoding, and caching images, specifically for chat attachments such as images.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image attachment from a given URI, scales it to fit within the max width, compresses it to meet size constraints, encodes it in Base64, and returns a PendingImageAttachment object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Bitmap
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 encoded string into a Bitmap, with optional downscaling to a maximum dimension; utilizes a cache to optimize repeated decoding.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Computes an appropriate sample size for decoding bitmaps to reduce memory usage while maintaining image quality within a maximum dimension.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a raw filename string, defaulting to 'image.jpg' if input is empty or invalid.
